about: Model-provider confinement falsifiers (cc-model-confine lane, tasks 006 and 004). Every entry but F-cc1e edits capsules/model-provider/confine.sb, which sandbox-exec reads at each launch, so a mutated profile needs no rebuild. F-cc1a turns (deny default) into (allow default) and F-cc1b widens the journal read/write grant from STORAGE_ROOT to STORAGE_PARENT; model_outside_write_denied then fails because the redirected journal write succeeds. F-cc1c widens the STORAGE_PARENT read from the parent alone to its subtree; model_outside_read_denied then fails because the run record outside STORAGE_ROOT is read and returned. F-cc1d leaves the STORAGE_ROOT grant write-only; model_outside_read_denied then fails at its first init, which cannot inspect the journal root. F-cc1e removes that test's one fixture rule from capsules/model-provider/tests/confine/main.rs, so the runner rebuilds the test; runs_get then stops at the record's existence check instead of its open, and the test fails. Each F-cc1-rm entry removes one allow rule and model_provider_ops_under_profile fails. The (deny network*) rule is held by the shared contract check in the wallet crate, which a provider-command list cannot run. The confined tests need /usr/bin/sandbox-exec and skip without it, so this list is a Mac gate. Files are relative to examples/agent-host.

falsifiers.title: the profile allows every operation by default
the journal read/write grant covers STORAGE_PARENT instead of STORAGE_ROOT
the profile no longer lets the provider binary execute
the profile no longer lets startup read the root directory
the profile no longer lets startup read kernel facts
the profile no longer lets init inspect STORAGE_PARENT
the profile no longer grants read/write under STORAGE_ROOT
the STORAGE_PARENT read covers the parent's whole subtree instead of the parent alone
the STORAGE_ROOT grant allows writes but no reads
the outside-read test grants no metadata read of the moved run record
